description: This file defines enums, constants, interfaces, and functions related to different vector store providers, including their display names, logos, configuration fields, and utility functions for retrieving provider info.

classes.name: VectorStoreFieldConfig
classes.description: Interface defining configuration for provider-specific vector store fields.

methods.name: getVectorStoreProviderLogoAndName
methods.description: Returns the logo URL and display name for a given provider value.

methods.name: getProviderSpecificFields
methods.description: Returns configuration fields for a specified provider.
